title: Parkari Koli language — Grokipedia
text: Parkari Koli is an Indo-Aryan language primarily spoken in the Sindh province of Pakistan, particularly in the Tharparkar district. Its autonym is "Parkari" or "Parkari Koli," reflecting its use among the Koli ethnic community in the region.
